title: Practice 3: в лесу, на берегу: the stressed -у

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том потолстел. Он уже не пролезает в ___ (дверь).
exercises.prompt: Tom has got fatter. He doesn't fit through doors any more.
exercises.why: Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions в or на. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 27.  ·  «Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions В or НА. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after О, ОБ.» — DLI, Lesson 27.
exercises.context: Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions в or на.
